title: Password Spraying
description: By attempting a small number of common passwords against a large number of accounts, an attacker can avoid account-lockout thresholds while still compromising accounts that use weak or predictable passwords. Exposed authentication portals and the absence of MFA make this attack reliably effective.
businessImpact: High --- even a single sprayed credential can provide an initial foothold, and the technique scales across the whole user population.
remediation:
- Enforce MFA on all externally reachable authentication.
- Screen passwords against common/breached password lists and enforce strong policy.
- Implement intelligent lockout and detection for distributed failed-logon patterns.
- Disable legacy authentication protocols and monitor sign-in telemetry.
